title: Запредельное давление Шефа  (The Chef's Sky-High Blood Pressure)

segments.t: Outside by the dumpsters, Max is annoyed when Rodion Sergeyevich once again critiques his overcooked vegetables. Inside the office, meanwhile, a dizzy Chef Barinov has his blood pressure checked by a doctor, who assumes he has been drinking heavily—until Barinov groans that he went jogging instead.
Такие же передержанные, как и вчера.
Так вот, значит, компетентный человек шефа.
Now let's break down each line of their conversation.
'Oh, al dente vegetables again.' Over the moment and the truth, Barinov answers Eleonora without a second thought.

'Just as overcooked as they were yesterday.' Vika reminds Barinov that just as overcooked as they were yesterday before the moment passes.

'So that is who the Chef's 'competent person' Because that is who the Chef person, Eleonora treats the matter as settled.
'And he has the nerve to lecture me.' Barinov reminds Eleonora that he has the nerve to lecture him before the moment passes.
'About how I roast my meat.' Over the conversation and the moment, Vika answers Barinov without a second thought.
'Oh, I feel awful.' Eleonora tells Barinov that she feels awful without dressing it up.

'Viktor Petrovich, you have been drinking again.' Pointing out that Eleonora has been drinking again gives Eleonora a sobering reality check. Even in the middle of the drama, he keeps the polite plural "you" that workplace Russian expects.

'Your blood pressure is through the roof.' Vika explains that Barinov's blood pressure is through the roof, keeping her voice calm and direct. In Russian you say "by me" or "with us" rather than "I have", so the situation sits right with the person.
'I have not been drinking.' Realizing that she has not been drinking changes how Eleonora handles the situation.
'Then what were you doing?' By wondering what Eleonora doing was, Barinov presses Eleonora for a straight answer. Notice how he sticks to the formal "you", keeping a professional line between them.
'I would have been better off drinking.' Even though she would have been better off drinking, Vika keeps a steady face in front of Barinov.
'Viktor Petrovich.' Around the work and moment, Eleonora sets a calm, everyday tone with Barinov.
'Tomorrow I am going jogging again.' Saying that tomorrow he is going jogging again is how Barinov sets the tone with Eleonora. Now let's put it all back together and hear the whole scene again.

Так вот, значит, компетентный человек шефа.

That wraps up this scene as max fumes when Rodion criticizes his vegetables again, and in the office a paramedic warns an exhausted Chef Barinov that his blood pressure is dangerously high. See you next time!
